digest.component_or_area: CI workflows and Git partial clone infrastructure
propositions: CI ticket-store fetches must apply --filter=blob:none to reduce transfer size from 1.04 GiB to 68.7 MiB for standalone checkout and from 6.73 minutes to 3.6 s for Gerrit verify-identity
actions/checkout@v7 steps in reconcile-bridge, verify-identity, and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows must include filter input while preserving fetch-depth: 0 and existing credentials/ref settings
Gerrit gerrit-verify.yaml direct-URL fetches must explicitly pass --filter=blob:none for both depth-1 require-ticket and full-history verify-identity operations
Production guards must parse git count-objects -v pack size immediately after materialization and reject fetches exceeding 102400 KiB (standalone) or 131072 KiB (Gerrit) thresholds

Real-Git fixture must instantiate a git daemon with uploadpack.allowFilter support, validate filter capability negotiation via GIT_TRACE_PACKET packet regex, and verify missing-blob behavior across three fetch modes
Verify-identity jobs must snapshot git count-objects -v before and after materialization and fail if any object differs, ensuring no promisor pack contamination occurs during identity scanning
